name: 428. xAI image generation refuses size and every field xAI does not take (xai image generation fields)
description: Pins TXE-6960 (contract C4) for xai on /v1/images/generations, /openai/v1/images/generations and /v1/async/images/generations (submitted, then polled: a refused job is failed with the 400 and the full error; the GET polls 202 until the job is terminal, up to 40 lookups). Before the change, size, style and output_compression were dropped silently and output_format, background, moderation, partial_images and input_images were forwarded to xAI, whose REST reference documents none of them. xAI generation now takes only n, response_format, aspect_ratio, resolution, quality and user (with seed and negative_prompt exempt as unpriced), and refuses every other unified field with 400 caller_unsupported_parameter naming it in error.param, before any upstream call. size is refused rather than mapped: xAI sizes an image by aspect_ratio and resolution, and a pixel size does not map onto one documented pair. style and output_compression are not price-affecting under C4, but they are refused too so the caller is told. Every case makes no upstream call and costs nothing. Unit tests in core/providers/xai/xai_test.go pin each refused field and the exempt fields.
